---
title: Moodle
description: Privacy rules for Moodle 4.5 LTS and 5.0 to 5.3 on MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL
---

Covers Moodle users' e-mail addresses, names, phones, addresses, IP addresses, password hashes, sessions, tokens, and secrets in core and bundled-plugin tables, plus messages and posts.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** 4.5 LTS and 5.0 to 5.3.
- **Engines:** MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. Moodle prefixes every table with `mdl_` by default (`$CFG->prefix` in `config.php`); prepend yours to every key.

## Template

<Tabs groupId="moodle-version" persist items={['4.5', '5.0', '5.1', '5.2', '5.3']} defaultIndex={4}>
<Tab value="4.5">

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - user.email
        - auth_oauth2_linked_login.email
        - oauth2_system_account.email
        - oauth2_issuer.systememail
        - badge_backpack.email
        - badge.issuercontact
        - badge_endorsement.issueremail
        - badge.imageauthoremail
        # Bundled activity and enrolment plugins (optional)
        - enrol_paypal.business
        - enrol_paypal.receiver_email
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - user.username
        - user.firstname
        - user.lastname
        - user.middlename
        - user.alternatename
        - user.firstnamephonetic
        - user.lastnamephonetic
        - tool_mfa.label
        - auth_oauth2_linked_login.username
        - oauth2_system_account.username
        - mnet_session.username
        - mnet_sso_access_control.username
        - repository_instances.username
        - user.moodlenetprofile
        - badge.imageauthorname
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    user-ids:
      columns:
        - user_devices.pushid
      entity: USER_ID
      operator: hash
    phones:
      columns:
        - user.phone1
        - user.phone2
        - sms_messages.recipientnumber
      entity: PHONE_NUMBER
      operator: hash
    addresses:
      columns:
        - user.address
        - user.city
      entity: LOCATION
      operator: hash
    companies:
      columns:
        - user.institution
        - user.department
        - badge.issuername
        - badge_endorsement.issuername
      entity: ORGANIZATION
      operator: hash
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - user.lastip
        - sessions.firstip
        - sessions.lastip
        - log.ip
        - mnet_log.ip
        - logstore_standard_log.ip
        - tool_mfa.createdfromip
        - external_tokens.iprestriction
        - external_services_users.iprestriction
        - user_private_key.iprestriction
        # Bundled activity and enrolment plugins (optional)
        - chat_users.ip
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        - user.description
        - user.imagealt
        # Messages and posts (optional)
        - messages.subject
        - messages.fullmessage
        - messages.fullmessagehtml
        - messages.smallmessage
        - notifications.subject
        - notifications.fullmessage
        - notifications.fullmessagehtml
        - notifications.smallmessage
        - message.subject
        - message.fullmessage
        - message.fullmessagehtml
        - message.smallmessage
        - message_read.subject
        - message_read.fullmessage
        - message_read.fullmessagehtml
        - message_read.smallmessage
        - forum_posts.subject
        - forum_posts.message
        - comments.content
        - post.subject
        - post.summary
        - post.content
        - grade_grades.feedback
        - tool_dataprivacy_request.comments
        - tool_dataprivacy_request.dpocomment
        - tool_policy_acceptances.note
        - sms_messages.content
        - ai_action_generate_text.prompt
        - ai_action_generate_text.generatedcontent
        - ai_action_summarise_text.prompt
        - ai_action_summarise_text.generatedcontent
        - ai_action_generate_image.prompt
        - ai_action_generate_image.revisedprompt
      entity: FREE_TEXT
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - user.password
        - user_password_history.hash
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    plaintext-passwords:
      columns:
        - badge_backpack.password
        - repository_instances.password
        - enrol.password
        - groups.enrolmentkey
        - course_request.password
        # Bundled activity and enrolment plugins (optional)
        - quiz.password
        - quiz_overrides.password
        - lti.password
        - bigbluebuttonbn.moderatorpass
        - bigbluebuttonbn.viewerpass
        - bigbluebuttonbn.guestpassword
      entity: PASSWORD
      operator: redact
    tokens:
      columns:
        - user.secret
        - user_password_resets.token
        - sessions.sid
        - external_tokens.sid
        - mnet_session.token
        - auth_oauth2_linked_login.confirmtoken
        - tool_mfa_secrets.sessionid
        # Bundled activity and enrolment plugins (optional)
        - chat_users.sid
      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    otp-secrets:
      columns:
        - tool_mfa.secret
        - tool_mfa_secrets.secret
      entity: OTP_SECRET
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - user_private_key.value
        - external_tokens.token
        - external_tokens.privatetoken
        - registration_hubs.token
        - registration_hubs.secret
        - oauth2_issuer.clientsecret
        - oauth2_system_account.refreshtoken
        - oauth2_access_token.token
        - oauth2_refresh_token.token
        - badge_backpack_oauth2.token
        - badge_backpack_oauth2.refreshtoken
        - messageinbound_datakeys.datakey
        # Bundled activity and enrolment plugins (optional)
        - lti.servicesalt
        - lti_tool_proxies.secret
        - lti_access_tokens.token
        - enrol_lti_tools.secret
        - enrol_lti_users.consumersecret
        - enrol_lti_lti2_consumer.secret
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - user_info_data.data
        - user_preferences.value
        - logstore_standard_log.other
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: replace
    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:
        - sessions.sessdata
        - config.value
        - config_plugins.value
        - portfolio_instance_user.value
        - repository_instance_config.value
        - sms_gateways.config
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: redact
```

        - ai_action_generate_text.prompt

        - ai_action_summarise_text.prompt

        - ai_action_explain_text.prompt

    passwords:

    plaintext-passwords:

    tokens:

        - auth_oauth2_linked_login.confirmtoken

      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    otp-secrets:
      columns:
        - tool_mfa.secret

    secrets:
      columns:

    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:

    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:

**Choices**

- `tool_mfa.label` holds the SMS factor's phone number, the e-mail factor's address, or a device name: ruled whole as `PERSON`. The `iprestriction` columns hold address lists and ranges.
- `user.secret` is the e-mail confirmation secret; `enrol.password` and `groups.enrolmentkey` are plaintext enrolment keys; 5.3's OAuth 2 `identifier` columns are ids inside issued tokens.
- `mixed-content-secrets` covers settings holding SMTP, LDAP, and plugin credentials, and the serialized session: keep it even if you drop `mixed-content`.
- Optional parts: delete the commented bundled-plugin columns you do not run, the messages and posts if the assistant should read them, and the `mixed-content` rule if it needs those columns readable.
- Custom profile fields are rows of `user_info_data.data`, ruled whole by `mixed-content`.

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `user.username`, `email`, the name columns, `city`; `sessions.sid`; `external_tokens.token`, `sid`; `user_private_key.value`; `mnet_session.token`; `mnet_sso_access_control.username`; `auth_oauth2_linked_login.username`; `user_devices.pushid`; `rest_api_tokens.token` (5.3); `enrol_paypal.business`, `receiver_email`; `lti_access_tokens.token`.
- **Lookups that stop working:** users by username, e-mail, name, city, or institution; sessions and web service tokens by value; log rows and sessions by IP address.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `user.id`, `user.idnumber`, every `userid`, `relateduserid` and `realuserid` in the log, `useridfrom` / `useridto`.
- **`user.idnumber`** is the join key to HR and student systems and holds employee or student numbers; rule it as `USER_ID` if you do not join on it.

## Not covered

- Activity content (quiz responses, assignment text, database, glossary, wiki, workshop, H5P, SCORM): free text in plugin tables.
- `files.author`, `filename`, `source`: names mixed with file metadata.
- `event.name`, `description`, `location`, `course_request.reason`, `enrol` `custom*`: free text or plugin settings.
- `enrol_lti` and `lti` keys (`consumerkey`, `sourceid`, `ltiuserkey`, `resourcekey`): identifiers shared with LTI platforms.
